consent.title: Recording consent
consent.label: I confirm that everyone who can be heard has been told this is being recorded and agrees to it, or that I am otherwise legally allowed to record them.
consent.help: Recording rules differ by country and state: some places require everyone’s consent. This is a reminder, not legal advice.
consent.notice: This meeting is being audio-recorded and turned into a written transcript and notes by MeetNotes. If you do not agree to be recorded, please tell the organiser now.
usage.title: Usage and AI limit
usage.explain: AI units are Cloudflare Workers AI “neurons”. Turning speech into text and writing the notes both use them.
usage.state.paused: Paused: the daily limit is reached
usage.free: Free allowance: {n} units a day for the whole Cloudflare account.
usage.costFree: No charge expected: within the free allowance.
usage.empty: No AI usage in this period.
usage.capHelp: When today’s total reaches this number, new processing pauses for everyone until 00:00 UTC. 0 turns the cap off. Keep it below the free allowance if you want to avoid charges.
usage.confirmOff: Turn the daily cap off? A busy day could go past the free allowance and be charged.
insights.title: Insights
insights.topicsHelp: Words that keep coming up in your notes, counted by how many meetings mention them.
insights.empty: Insights appear once you have finished a few meetings.
landing.tagline: Record a meeting. Get the summary, decisions and action items.
landing.lead: MeetNotes turns a meeting recording into a written transcript and clear notes, in English, Hindi or Tamil.
landing.b1.title: Notes you can act on
landing.b1.body: A short summary, the decisions made, and action items with an owner and due date when they were mentioned.
landing.b2.title: Record or upload
landing.b2.body: Record in the app or upload a file. A recording in progress survives a crash, and meetings recorded offline are sent when you are back online.
landing.b3.title: English, Hindi and Tamil
landing.b3.body: English and Hindi work well when you choose the spoken language. Tamil is experimental: expect mistakes and check the transcript.
landing.b4.title: You stay in control
landing.b4.body: Edit the transcript and notes, export them, and delete a meeting and its audio at any time. Recording needs everyone's consent, and the app asks you to confirm it.
landing.approval: New accounts are approved by an administrator before first use.
landing.footer: Notes are written by AI and can contain mistakes. Check anything important.
sample.banner: This is a sample. Nothing here was recorded and it is not saved to your account.
sample.title: Product launch planning
sample.summary: The team agreed to launch the new website on Friday after a final check of the pricing page. Marketing will send the press release the day before, and the budget for launch advertising was approved at the level proposed. Hiring for the support role will start next week.
sample.decision1: Launch the new website on Friday.
sample.decision2: Approve the launch advertising budget as proposed.
sample.decision3: Start hiring for the support role next week.
sample.action1.task: Send the press release to the newsroom list
sample.action2.task: Final check of the pricing page
sample.t1: Let us start with the launch date. Is Friday still realistic?
sample.t2: Yes, as long as the pricing page is checked once more on Thursday.
sample.t3: I can do that check. Priya, when will the press release go out?
sample.t4: The day before, so Thursday morning, to the full newsroom list.
sample.t5: Good. On budget, the advertising plan fits what we proposed, so I suggest we approve it.
sample.t6: Agreed. Last thing: hiring for the support role should start next week.
sample.t7: Meera, can you post the description on Monday?
sample.t8: Yes, I will post it on Monday. That is everything from my side.

onboarding.title: Welcome to MeetNotes
onboarding.intro: Three steps to your first notes:
onboarding.s1: Choose the language that will be spoken, and confirm everyone knows the meeting is being recorded.
onboarding.s2: Record the meeting, or upload a recording you already have.
onboarding.s3: Wait a few minutes. The summary, decisions, action items and transcript appear here, and you can edit them.
update.ready: A new version of MeetNotes is ready.

retention.label: Keep audio recordings
retention.help: After this time the recording is deleted automatically. The transcript, summary and action items stay. Checked once a day.
retention.overridden: Not needed while "Delete audio after notes are generated" is on, which already deletes the audio sooner.
captions.privacy: In Chrome and Edge, your browser sends the audio to its speech service (Google or Microsoft) to make these captions. Leave this off for confidential meetings. Nothing from it is saved.
captions.unsupported: Live captions are not available in this browser. They work in Chrome and Edge.
captions.title: Live captions (preview)
captions.note: A rough preview only. The real transcript is made after you stop, and is usually more accurate.
captions.denied: Live captions are blocked (microphone or speech service not allowed). Recording continues normally.
captions.network: Live captions need an internet connection and stopped. Recording continues normally.
captions.language: This browser cannot caption the chosen language. Recording continues normally.
captions.unavailable: Live captions stopped working. Recording continues normally.
